          Technical Architecture of the AMC Process

          Module layers, data model, state machines, process flows, pricing / billing / scheduling engines, integration with the warranty service chain, security, reliability, configuration, migration, testing and extension points.

          amc_managementamc_management_warrantyamc_management_service10 diagrams

          1. Architecture overview#

          The AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) solution is implemented as one standalone core module and two optional bridge modules. The core owns the complete commercial and contractual lifecycle (plans, pricing, contracts, entitlements, billing, renewals). The bridges connect it to the warranty solution without modifying any warranty file: they extend warranty models by inheritance and act only on records linked to an AMC.

          1.1 Architectural principles#

          • Separation (SRS 2.1 / 2.12): AMC stages, formulas, visits and billing never live on the warranty card; the core depends only on mail, product, sale_management and stock.
          • Reuse of standard Odoo: quotations / Sales Orders, invoicing on delivered quantities, payments, activities, chatter, Helpdesk, Field Service and worksheets are reused rather than re-implemented.
          • Mandatory service chain: AMC visits are executed through Helpdesk Ticket → Warranty Case → Service Job → Field Service Task (bridge amc_management_service).
          • Server-side integrity: every state, price, schedule and link field is written only by server actions protected by non-serialisable Python marker objects; the UI, imports and RPC cannot forge them.
          • Scoped extension: every override of a shared model calls super() and acts only when an AMC link exists (amc_contract_id, case_type = amc + contract, AMC order lines).
          • Idempotent automation: generation, releases and the daily scheduler can run repeatedly without duplicates.

          1.2 Module layers#

          ModuleDepends onResponsibility
          amc_managementmail, product, sale_management, stockPlans, billing plans, pricing engine, opportunities, contracts, overrides, quotations, entitlements (visits), billing schedule, lifecycle, scheduler, report
          amc_management_warrantyamc_management, warranty_managementAuto-create draft AMC on warranty confirmation, Convert to AMC, warranty units on covered equipment, AMC offer on warranty expiry, smart buttons
          amc_management_serviceamc_management, warranty_management_fsmService requests (ticket + AMC case), AMC eligibility, Service Job / worksheet / completion / cancellation hooks, pending AMC services on tickets, AMC ticket tag
          warranty_meta_dependenciesall custom addonsInstalls the complete solution in one step
          i
          Design note

          No warranty module depends on an AMC module, so the AMC modules can be installed, upgraded or removed independently. Neither bridge is auto_install.

          3. Data model#

          The ERD on the next page shows the AMC models and their links to Sales, the warranty card / unit and the warranty service chain. All transactional AMC models carry company_id (stored) for multi-company record rules.

          3.2 Integrity constraints#

          • UNIQUE(contract_id, line_id, visit_type, unit_no, sequence_no) on amc.contract.visit – no duplicate entitlement.
          • UNIQUE(name, company_id) on amc.plan.
          • Covered quantity > 0 and whole; a serial line covers quantity 1; a serial / warranty unit belongs to one open contract only (predecessor and renewal excepted); plan applicability by pricelist, product and category.
          • Plan: counts ≥ 0, visits fit into the duration at the frequency, Per Preventive Visit billing requires activation on SO confirmation.
          • Formula: non-negative amounts, min ≤ max, effective_to ≥ effective_from, valid Hybrid expression, tiers without gaps / overlaps, unique factor per product / category, unique rounding rule per currency.
          • Company consistency: plan / contract, warranty unit / contract, AMC case / contract.

          4.2 Entitlement (visit) lifecycle#

          i
          Design note

          Consumption (_amc_consume) is the only path to completed. It validates the open state, a running contract, the coverage period and – for usage-based visits – a positive, non-decreasing usage reading, and is called either by manual completion (core without service bridge) or inside the warranty job completion savepoint (service bridge).

          6. Core engines#

          6.1 Pricing engine#

          MethodCalculation
          fixedfixed_amount
          per_unitΣ unit_rate × quantity × factor(line)
          per_visitvisit_rate × visit_count × covered quantity (entitlements, not physical visits)
          percentageΣ equipment_value × percentage / 100 × factor(line)
          tieredrate of the tier containing quantity (or site count) × that basis
          sitesite_rate × number of distinct sites
          usageusage_base + usage_rate × expected usage
          hybridcontrolled expression over equipment_value, quantity, visit_count, contract_months, usage, site_count, factor, min_price, max_price

          Snapshot. action_compute_price stores formula, version, method, formula currency and amount, exchange rate, conversion date, calculated price and the textual breakdown on the contract. The quotation is refused if the snapshot is not from today (approved C3); confirmation freezes it (price_approved_date).

          Controlled expression (amc_safe_expression). The Hybrid expression is parsed with ast.parse(mode="eval") and checked against a whitelist: numeric constants, approved variable names, + − * /, unary ±, and calls of min, max, round, abs with positional arguments. Attributes, subscripts, comparisons, power, lambdas, strings and any other name are rejected; length is limited to 500 characters; evaluation is a custom tree walk – eval / safe_eval are never used; division by zero raises a business error.

          6.2 Entitlement generation#

          amc.contract._amc_generate_visits() runs once at activation (idempotent: returns existing visits). For every line and every covered unit (quantity rounded to whole units):

          • Period plans: Visit Count preventive visits; due date n = start + n × (12 / frequency) months (fractional months as 30-day days), capped at end_date.
          • Usage plans: usage_due n = n × usage_interval, no due date.
          • Free services: Included Free Services on-demand entitlements without due date.

          Monitoring fields are stored computes (alert_date = due − alert days for Alert-Driven plans, grace_end_date = due + grace days); due_status is written by actions and the scheduler only when it changes.

          6.3 Billing engine#

          StepMethodDetail
          Quotation lines_amc_quotation_linesquantity = billing periods; unit price = value / periods; final period absorbs the rounding difference
          Schedule_amc_generate_billingone amc.billing.line per ordered unit, mapped to its sale.order.line (on SO confirmation)
          Dates_amc_schedule_billing(release)upfront: start; periodic: advance = period start, arrears = period end (capped at end); per visit: linked preventive visit
          Releaseamc.billing.line._amc_releaseplanned → released; sale line qty_delivered = released count (contract marker); chatter log
          Invoicingaction_create_invoicesale.order._create_invoices() of the released quantities – draft only
          Activation on paymentaccount.move._invoice_paid_hookAwaiting Payment contract of the invoiced AMC order → _amc_activate
          i
          Design note

          Billing reuses the standard "invoice on delivered quantity" mechanism of a manual service product, so taxes, fiscal positions, journals, payment terms and accounting entries remain 100 % standard Odoo.

          7.2 AMC eligibility (service bridge)#

          warranty.case._amc_run_checks() replaces the warranty-card checks for AMC cases with a contract and returns the same tuple as the warranty engine (result, steps, payment values, failure values), so Check Eligibility, Approve Case and the confirmation revalidation of the Service Job work unchanged. Checks: contract Active or Expiring; ticket date (service date of the warranty engine) inside the contract period; visits linked, of this contract and still Scheduled / In Progress; overdue receivables shown as information.

          7.3 Warranty integration (warranty bridge)#

          • _amc_auto_create – after a successful confirmation, per company mode: Draft opportunity or Draft contract (units as lines, start = warranty end + 1 if ahead); savepoint + log on failure; never twice per card.
          • action_convert_to_amc – Confirmed / Expired cards; opens the open AMC of the card instead of creating a second one.
          • amc.contract.line.warranty_unit_id – unit of the customer and company, state Active / Expired / Suspended, one open contract per unit.
          • _warranty_apply_expiry – optional to-do for the card's service alert users.

          8.1 Access control#

          ModelUserCoordinatorManagerApproverHelpdesk / FSM*
          amc.plan, amc.billing.plan, amc.pricing.*RRRWCDRR (plan)
          amc.opportunityRWCRWCRWCDRWC—
          amc.contractRWCRWCRWCDRWCR
          amc.contract.lineRWCDRWCDRWCDRWCDR
          amc.contract.visitRRWRWRR
          amc.billing.lineRRRR—
          amc.price.overrideRRWCRWCRW—

          * granted by amc_management_service. Record rules restrict every transactional model to company_id in company_ids; configuration models allow shared (company-less) records.

          8.2 Protected fields (marker pattern)#

          Each model keeps a module-level object() as marker (_CONTRACT_MARKER, _FORMULA_MARKER, _OVERRIDE_MARKER, _OPPORTUNITY_MARKER). Server code writes protected fields with with_context(amc_contract_marker=_CONTRACT_MARKER); write() / create() refuse protected keys when the context value is not that exact object. A Python object cannot be serialised into a JSON-RPC context, so neither the web client, imports nor external RPC can bypass the guard, and sudo() alone does not pass it either.

          PROTECTED_FIELDS = {'state', 'price_state', 'calculated_price', 'sale_order_id', 'contract_months',
                    'renewal_of_id', 'close_reason', ... }
def write(self, vals):
    if self.env.context.get('amc_contract_marker') is not _CONTRACT_MARKER:
        if PROTECTED_FIELDS & set(vals): raise UserError(...)
    return super().write(vals)

          8.3 Privilege elevation (sudo) boundaries#

          • Only after an explicit group check in the calling action, or for system consequences of an authorised standard event (SO confirmation by a salesman, payment by an accountant, job completion by a technician).
          • Internal writes of billing lines and entitlements (users have no write right on billing lines).
          • Cross-record chatter logs and activities.

          9. Transactions, concurrency and reliability#

          ConcernMechanism
          Double click / concurrent quotation, activation, renewal_amc_lock(): parameterised SELECT … FOR UPDATE on the contract row
          Atomic consumption with job completionconsumption in _warranty_complete_case, inside the warranty completion savepoint; any AMC error rolls back the whole completion
          Warranty confirmation must not fail because of AMCauto-create inside a savepoint; error logged on the card
          Scheduler failuresone savepoint per contract; _logger.exception; next contract continues
          Duplicate generationvisits generated only if none exist; billing only if no non-cancelled line exists; unique constraint
          Duplicate release / alert / renewalstate filters (planned only), alert_sent flag, one open renewal check

          11. Deployment and testing#

          11.1 Data migration#

          None: the AMC modules are not yet used in production, so they ship without migration scripts. A database with an older AMC version is reinstalled (or upgraded on a copy and checked) rather than migrated.

          11.2 Deployment#

          pg_dump -Fc <db> > before_amc_110.dump   (+ filestore)
odoo-bin -c odoo.conf -d <copy> -u amc_management -i amc_management_warranty,amc_management_service --stop-after-init
validate (docs/14 §4), then repeat on the target database with the server stopped

          i
          Design note

          Keep new logic scoped to AMC records, call super() in every override, write protected fields only through the marker helpers (_marked) and add a test with a TC identifier to the relevant suite.
